description: With ids, those photos (up to 10), with a preview of each ready one once none is working: how to fetch an edit's result. While one is working it waits up to 25 seconds for it. Without, the user's latest shoots, newest first, five at a time; pass the answer's next as before for the five after. With uploads true, the photos the user added in the app (My photos) and those made from them, newest first, ten at a time, paged the same way: an old print to restore, clothes to try on, something to add. ids are found in whichever space holds them; the lists are of one space.

space.description: The space, by its id or name from list_spaces; left out, the personal one, but a shoot names one when the user is in several. When they haven't said which, ask.
